name: Ops in-flight chain-progress observation
description: Fires every fire_every_n_events=5 completed non-terminal loops (researcher-* / reviewer-spec / builder) to wake an ops-progress-observer that assesses whether an in-flight chain is making forward progress or spinning. Complements configs/rules/ops/chain-terminal-observe.json (which fires only at reviewer-qa terminal — purely retrospective). Smoke #25c (2026-05-14) motivated this: a 12-minute builder stall surfaced no graph-level signal until the run hit the watcher timeout; an in-flight observer would have had three opportunities to flag the pattern before the operator did manually. Phase 1 read-only contract per ADR-027 — emits findings via emit_diagnosis only.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.ops-progress-observer
on_enter.prompt: An in-flight observation pulse fired after a non-terminal chain loop completed at $entity.instance. Walk the active chain (start from the trigger loop in your task properties, walk agent.loop.parent up to the chain root, inventory all loops belonging to this chain). Apply your `10-progress-rules.md` checks: spinning patterns, stalled patterns, cost-acceleration patterns. Emit findings via emit_diagnosis ONLY when a pattern crosses a threshold — empty findings is the expected outcome on a healthy chain. When done, call submit_work with a one-line status.

metadata.motivated_by: Smoke #25c (2026-05-14) — builder stalled for 12 min, no graph-level signal surfaced the pattern until watcher timeout. project_smoke25_findings.md.
metadata.scope_exclusion_note: Conditions exclude reviewer-qa (terminal — handled by chain-terminal-observe.json) and the three ops-* roles themselves (avoids infinite recursion: an ops observer completing would otherwise fire another ops observer).
metadata.fire_cadence: Every 5 completed non-terminal loops. The MVP chain has at most 6 non-terminal completions (plan, gather, synthesize, architect, reviewer-spec, builder), so on a clean chain this rule fires roughly once mid-flight. Adjust fire_every_n_events lower if real-LLM smokes show needed earlier surfacing.
